title: demo.mobile_otp@v1 request (EXAMPLE ONLY, not a frozen contract)
description: Example capability for examples/otp-account-flow (HUB-342). Not part of contracts/: a production OTP capability goes through the contract-steward. Step 1 (no X-Hub-Session): send an OTP to `mobile`. Step 2 (X-Hub-Session from step 1): verify `otp`. Both steps share one operation because an integration version has one transformer pair for every operation today (HUB-343); the intended shape is two operations, `send_otp` and `verify_otp`.

default.description: Send an OTP (step 1) or verify it inside the session step 1 opened (step 2).

mobile.description: Indian mobile number in E.164 form.

otp.description: The OTP the user typed. Step 2 only; ignored on step 1.
